shadowHints.message: pnpm installed its own node. Run `pnpm remove -g node` so vfox's node runs.
mise installed its own node. Run `mise unuse -g node` and `mise uninstall --all node` so vfox's node runs.
asdf installed its own node. Run `asdf uninstall nodejs <version>` and drop it from `.tool-versions` so vfox's node runs.
nvm installed its own node. Run `nvm deactivate` in this shell so vfox's node runs.
Homebrew installed its own node. Run `brew unlink node` (or `brew uninstall node`) so vfox's node runs.
A Node.js installed outside vfox (winget or the official installer) comes before vfox in PATH. Run `winget uninstall -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS` so vfox's node runs.
